gloss: to take along; to bring (people) with one

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {引|ひ}き{連|つ}れませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {引|ひ}き{連|つ}れていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {引|ひ}き{連|つ}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to take along; to bring (people) with one; to lead
definitions.explanation: To bring along one or more people, typically as companions or followers. Implies leading or having others accompany you, often with a sense of being in charge of the group.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{連|つ}れて⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: He headed to the site with his subordinates in tow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{連|つ}れて⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I took the children along to the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{連|つ}れて⟦{海外|かいがい}{出張|しゅっちょう}→海外出張：24173_kaigaishucchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: The company president set off on an overseas business trip with a large entourage of staff.

notes:
USAGE:
The object is always people (or sometimes animals), marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. The expression implies that the subject is the leader or the one in charge of the group.
More dramatic or formal than ⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to take someone along). Often used in narratives or news reporting to convey the image of someone leading a group.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{連|つ}れて (taking ~ along)
- ⟦{大勢|おおぜい}→大勢：02850_oozei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{引|ひ}き{連|つ}れる (to bring along a large group)
